senses.ms_definition: Bentuk asing yang belum disahkan; mungkin merujuk secara kolektif kepada anggota keluarga fiksyen Hightopp.
senses.nuances: 名词分类及家族解释均以影视语境为条件。若确为该专名，正文应写 Hightopps。Disney 官方资料确认角色名 Tarrant Hightopp，但不能仅凭此确定输入词的出处：[Disney 角色资料](https://movies.disney.com/alice-through-the-looking-glass)。以下组合仅作条件性示例，未核实为高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Disney identifies the Mad Hatter as Tarrant Hightopp in its film materials. Hightopps can consequently be understood as an English family plural in an appropriate context. Its occurrence in a Malay text could reflect an untranslated name rather than a Malay borrowing. The supplied packet contains no source sentence, so that identification remains provisional.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若影视语境确认：Hightopp 是姓，英语复数加 s 表示一家人；不要把 hightopps 硬拆成马来语词根。
